datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a monthly schedule across Chad in 2016. Geographic data representing food insecurity phases were compiled into spatial datasets (GeoJSON/KML) for February, June, and October projections, with classifications indicating severity of acute food insecurity by administrative area.
